property_summary: For any caller, a call to Initialized() always succeeds on the reference contract (because nonReentrant_ resets locked_ to false after the call), but the mutant that never resets locked_ will cause Initialized() to succeed only the first time and revert on subsequent calls, so there exist inputs (repeated calls) where the mutant fails while the reference always allows the call to complete.
change_summary: Modify the nonReentrant_ modifier to set locked_ to true but never reset it to false, preventing Initialized from ever executing successfully after first use.
